cita_literal: On 11 May 2017 Etienne Jornod was re-elected as Executive Chairman with his remuneration to be exclusively in shares blocked until 2020. The management team of Vifor Pharma was strengthened with the appointment of Stefan Schulze as President of the Executive Committee and COO effective 11 May 2017
notes: No CEO title existed at Vifor Pharma in 2017-2019: Etienne Jornod was Executive Chairman (top executive; R3 case with CEO post vacant, not a CEO title), Stefan Schulze was President of the Executive Committee and COO from 11 May 2017; Schulze was appointed CEO only as of 14 May 2020 (PR 12 Mar 2020). Source: issuer press release 'Vifor Pharma Group reports strong 2017 results' (15 Mar 2018), hosted on CSL newsroom (Vifor acquired by CSL; viforpharma.com now redirects there), p6 'Management team strengthened'. Vifor 2017 annual report not found online (viforpharma.com gone). Local file: vifor_pr20180315.pdf

cita_literal: Stefan Schulze, currently President of the Executive Committee and Chief Operating Officer (COO) is appointed CEO for Vifor Pharma Group as of May 14, 2020.
notes: No CEO title in 2019: same release p2 'Commenting on the 2019 results, Etienne Jornod, Executive Chairman of Vifor Pharma Group, said:'; Jornod states he 'decided to accompany the first phase of Vifor Pharma's entrepreneurial independence ... and to run the plan Milestone 2020'. So on 31/10/2019 Jornod was Executive Chairman (R3 candidate, CEO vacant) and Schulze President of the Executive Committee and COO; first CEO title from 14 May 2020. Issuer FY2019 results press release (12 Mar 2020) on CSL newsroom. Vifor 2019 annual report not found online. Local file: vifor_pr20200312.pdf

cita_literal: En esta cifra se incluye la remuneración percibida por D. Javier Hernani Burzako desde su nombramiento como Consejero Delegado el 27 de abril de 2017
notes: DISCREPANCY: BME (Bolsas y Mercados Españoles, SDAD Holding de Mdos y Stmas Fin., S.A., NIF A-83246314) IAGC 2017, CNMV copy (registro 2018027066, 28/02/2018), H section note on C.1.15. On 31/10/2017 the Consejero Delegado (legal CEO title, R1) was Javier Hernani Burzako (appointed 27/04/2017); Antonio Zoido Martínez was executive Chairman ('Presidente', consejero ejecutivo), not CEO. Same report p7 C.1.3 consejeros ejecutivos: 'DON ANTONIO ZOIDO MARTINEZ PRESIDENTE DON JAVIER HERNANI BURZAKO CONSEJERO DELEGADO'; p6 C.1.2 'DON JAVIER HERNANI BURZAKO Ejecutivo CONSEJERO DELEGADO 27/04/2017'; p12 C.1.10 'DON JAVIER HERNANI BURZAKO Breve descripción: El Consejero Delegado tiene delegadas la totalidad de las facultades del Consejo de Administración'. Hernani was Director General before April 2017 (p58). Zoido could only count via R3 if the CEO post were vacant, which it was not. Linked from cnmv.es/portal/consultas/ee/informaciongobcorp?nif=A-83246314 (old bolsasymercados.es report URLs now 404). Local file: bme_iagc2017.pdf
